note: No `contextId`: the setting belongs to one trust context, and a VTA answers about no context the caller does not name (VTI-NTF-094, VTI-NTF-096).
Unknown member — asking for every context's setting at once — is refused: a party sees only the contexts it has standing in (VTI-NTF-096).
`changedBy` without `changedAt`: who last changed the setting and when are stated together or not at all.
No `suspendedByOperator`: a principal reading `disabled` in vta/collection/list must be able to tell its own context's setting from an operator's suspension (VTI-NTF-098).
